$comment: SYNTHETIC. The `**` glob spelling, borrowed from the deny list two lines
below it — which is where an operator learns it. `Read(//mnt/secrets-store/**)`
is a real path glob, so `mcp__github__**` looks like the same idea applied
It now is: a `*` spans anything, so the doubled form reaches the same tools
the single one does. It used to reach none of them — one trailing `*` was
stripped and the remaining one was matched as a literal asterisk — so the
whole surface was silently inert. The row is kept because the spelling is
one an operator will keep writing, and 'it happens to work' is worth as
much of a test as 'it happens not to'.
